We measure the elastic and frictional material characteristics, E, G, P, Damping, asymmetry, relative porosity and correlate with EAB and UTS. We apply this for material characterization, material evolution and Quality Control. As a full NDT technology, destructive parameters can be correlated from NDT measurements on production parts.
We have a focus on new materials and Additive Manufacturing and reveal key information on materials microstructure, dissipative microcracks and even dislocations.

description:
Sasken Finland Oy is a design and product partner for wireless systems, helping our customers develop smart and sustainable solutions of the future. We combine over 30 years of product development experience with deep expertise in embedded systems, electronics, and hardware. We help our customers accelerate innovation and bring ideas to market cost-effectively, from concept and prototype development to production-ready solutions.

At the forefront of product engineering and space services, Sasken creates solutions that redefine industries and power billions of devices worldwide. With a 30+ year legacy and a track record of transforming Fortune 500 companies, Sasken leverages deep engineering expertise to deliver next-gen innovations. We help customers across space, semiconductor, automotive, consumer electronics, satellite communications, industrial, enterprise devices, telecom, and transportation from concept-to-market and chip-to-cognition.

Sasken is a company which is specialized in antenna, electronics, RF, mechanics, audio, camera, PCB and software. Sasken works as ODM, Original Design Manufacturer, and has history over 30 years working with critical communications devices and infrastructure.

Sasken has delivered e.g Inmarsat IsatPhone (all aspects of device), critical communication LTE satellite system Widestar III for Japan governmental use and many other terrestrial and non-terrestrial terminals, gateways and related systems.

Sasken has good in-house laboratories which can be utilised in R&D programs and enable seamless verification in accredited laboratories for final product. Sasken has also good network of EMS providers around the globe.

entityDescription: The Other World Lab (TOWL) is a newly established European start-up at the intersection of biotechnology and space based in Portugal. Founded with the objective of transforming microgravity from a scientific curiosity into a strategic tool for pharmaceutical development, TOWL is structured from inception to act as a contract research organisation (CRO) with a its mission is to reduce the time and cost of drug development by introducing microgravity research into the discovery and preclinical phases.By combining orbital crystallisation with advanced analytics and AI-driven design, TOWL seeks to shorten development timelines, rescue stalled pharmaceutical assets, and accelerate the availability of therapies for patients with rare diseases. From the outset, the company is positioned not only to generate intellectual property but to act as a strategic partner for industry and regulators, ensuring that space-enabled science translates into clinical and commercial impact. While early in its trajectory, TOWL is deliberately positioned within a governance and partnership ecosystem that lends credibility and institutional depth: a non-executive board spanning space technology, regulatory pharma, legal/IP, software & AI, and funding & policy engagement ensures that strategic decisions are externally validated.

entityDescription:
IntuitivAnalytix.com (IAG) specializes in Geographic Analytics (GA), Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Data Analytics, Data Science, and Artificial Intelligence. IAG offers consulting and software in these areas.
IAG follows a „starting with the end in mind”, business-canvas-driven methodology to quickly derive market-oriented hands-on recommendations. This allows IAG to achieve results in 20% of the time compared to traditional data analytics driven approaches. At the same time, IAG puts great emphasis on transparency and intuitive understanding of data.
​IAG leverages satellite imaging paired with pattern / image recognition and AI to drive easy-to-use and intuitive spatial management decision systems. We aim to replace complex & expensive ground-based management systems with highly cost and time-efficient space observations. 
The project ESA-GEOCAP aims at establishing a Data-as-a-Service platform combining satellite-based air-pollution indicators with Community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) data to analyze geo-correlations between environmental factors and CAP. With this, IAG enables decision makers in the Public Health Sector (i.e. Health Insurers, Hospitals, government agencies) to find new connections between air-pollutants and CAP in order to take appropriate countermeasures.

The project ESA-GEOCAP aims at establishing a Data-as-a-Service platform combining satellite-based air-pollution indicators with Community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) data to analyze geo-correlations between environmental factors and CAP. With this, IAG enables decision makers in the Public Health Sector (i.e. Health Insurers, Hospitals, government agencies) to find new connections between air-pollutants and CAP in order to take appropriate countermeasures.

entityDescription: At Orcintech, we combine big data analytics, cloud computing, and AI to deliver actionable insights for environmental and infrastructure sustainability. Our platform integrates satellite imagery, drone footage, IoT sensor networks, and GIS-based predictive modeling to generate detailed ecological reports and conservation strategies. As an example, in 2025, Orcintech was awarded a contract by the Canadian Space Agency (CSA) for developing an AI-powered cloud-based multi-technology platform to prevent moose-vehicle collisions and protect biodiversity. This project will reduce accidents, improve conservation, and support sustainable infrastructure. By integrating community knowledge with cutting-edge technology, including satellite data, drone imageries, and IoT sensors for safer roads while protecting Canada’s biodiversity. Orcintech’s TerraXai Cloud-Intelligent Platform is a cutting-edge, cloud-based system that fuses AI and Remote Sensing (RS) for near real-time environmental decision intelligence. Designed as a fully cloud-native, AI-driven system, TerraXai integrates multi-source data streams, including satellite imagery, aerial and UAV datasets, IoT telemetry, and ground-based sensors, within a unified data fabric and governance framework. Through its agentic AI pipeline, the platform automates every stage of the data lifecycle: from ingestion and benchmarking to model training, validation, and autonomous deployment. This architecture enables continuous, stream-based data processing and event analytics, allowing users to generate nearreal-time insights into environmental nd infrastructure resilience. TerraXai’s modular design ensures flexibility and scalability, supporting applications that range from land reclamation monitoring to disasterresponse, habitat mapping, and climate-risk assessment. The uniqueness of TerraXai lies in its AI-driven Decision Intelligence Suite, designed to synthesize multi-source geospatial data into interpretable and operational environmental intelligence. Integrated analytic modules, including vegetation intelligence and biomass analytics, wildfire prediction and early-warning systems, and wildlife management and ecosystem resilience assessment, provide end-to-end situational awareness for environmental managers, regulators, and researchers. The platform’s secure data dissemination and edge-synchronization architecture enables seamless collaboration between cloud and field operations, ensuring real-time information exchange, rapid decision-making, and streamlined regulatory reporting. By uniting AI, Earth Observation (EO), and cloud computing within a single, intelligent ecosystem, TerraXai delivers unmatched analytical depth, transparency, and operational agility. This powerful integration positions Orcintech at the forefront of digital environmental intelligence, driving innovation in sustainable land management and evidence-based environmental stewardship.

entityName: L-Universita' ta' Malta - Dept. of Anatomy
entityDescription:
The Anatomy Department, situated on campus, is one of the first departments to welcome students starting the Medical course. The Anatomy Department also services the B.Pharm. and Medical Biochemistry courses within the Faculty of Medicine and Surgery, as well as most of the paramedical courses within the Faculty of Health Sciences, both at under- and post- graduate level. The Department of Anatomy also collaborates with the Faculty of Dental Surgery and the Faculty of Engineering.

The Department hosts a Lecture Hall, a Histology Demonstration Lab equipped with audiovisual equipment, two Dissection halls with a depository of prosected specimens, Living Anatomy demonstration rooms, and a number of rooms for small group tutorial discussion sessions. A facility is also available for quiet study.

Tuition within the Department of Anatomy has shifted to emphasize the applied aspect of Anatomy. Clinicians from various clinical fields including different specialities of surgery, general practice, obstetrics and gynaecology, pathology, forensics and cytogenetics are involved in teaching at all levels together with specialist academics. Clinical visits to various departments in the nearby Mater Dei Hospital are also held, to help illustrate the clinical relevance of the subject.

The Department of Anatomy carries out Biomedical Research into local natural products. Other areas of interest include embryology, cytogenetics and epidemiology of birth defects, stem cell and cancer differentiation, gene regulation and pedagogical research. Collaborations with various European and International universities and hospitals are ongoing and around 30% of the student body who make use of the Anatomy Department are International Students studying in Malta.

Published by Bulgarian Science Ltd (Srod. "Balgarska Nauka") has established itself as the leading scientific media outlet in Bulgaria. Since its inception in 2005, it has evolved from a monthly magazine into a dynamic digital ecosystem connecting the scientific community with the general public.
Our Mission & Evolution What started as a passion project to distribute accessible scientific knowledge for free has grown into a comprehensive platform. We provide a stage for Bulgarian scientists to reach a wide audience, fostering a society that values critical thinking and verified information.
Building on nearly two decades of trust, Bulgarian Science now operates a hybrid model combining free content and a subscription-based digital platform:
- The Magazine: An archive of over 200 issues featuring original articles and research.

- Education: Structured courses and practical guides designed to solve real-life problems through the scientific method.

- Multimedia: A rich library of video and audio content, including interviews with top researchers - over 700 videos, over 1000 audio files and hundreds of interviews in text, audio and video). We have our own audio and video studio for creating audio and visual materials for science communication.

- Community: A social network for knowledge-seekers, students, and educators.

We believe that change starts with the individual. Through persistence and quality content, Bulgarian Science continues to prove that science is not just for the lab—it is a tool for a better life.

- Flexibility: continuous or pulsed operation
- Adjustability: selectable ion charge state and velocity, offering adjustable intensity and thus variable thrust.

These caracteristics position our technology as a enabler of profitable in-space logistics missions (last mile delivery, satellite repositioning, deorbiting).

entityDescription:
Chalmers in central Göteborg on the Swedish West Coast is a university of technology in which research and teaching are conducted on a broad front within technology, natural science and architecture. Our inspiration lies in the joy of discovery and the desire to learn. Underlying everything we do is a wish to contribute to sustainable development both in Sweden and world-wide.

Our research work deals ultimately with improving people¿s conditions, and we often cross traditional boundaries in order to solve the problems of the future. Chalmers has become strong within several areas of science, and some of our research leads its field internationally. We wish in particular to develop and strengthen our research in the fields of bioscience, information technology, environmental science and nanotechnology.

Chalmers is a pioneer in Europe in the field of start-up companies, and has built up an efficient system of innovation in order to find applications in research into the formation of companies. 

Chalmers has great aspirations to develop continually by opening doors to the outside world and by thinking innovatively. We have a close and productive collaboration with business and society at large. In this way we reinforce our own development, at the same time as we contribute to the growth of society.

Chalmers was founded in 1829 as a result of a donation from the director of the Swedish East India Company, William Chalmers.

entityDescription:
Waves of Change is a non-profit coalition based in Biarritz, France, founded in 2019. Its mission is to help coastal cities around the world become “future proof” by fostering sustainable and resilient development of their ecosystems. The organization brings together a diverse set of stakeholders — including startups, research centers, corporations, NGOs, public-sector actors, investors, and local communities — to collaborate on environmental challenges.

Waves of Change focuses on seven main areas (verticals): coastal adaptation, water management, waste & circularity, sustainable mobility, energy transition, sustainable tourism & local communities, and biodiversity & public health.
It also supports two horizontal dimensions: talent development and funding, to ensure long-term viability and innovation capacity.
Some of their past initiatives include: creating a system for marine pollution monitoring and bioremediation, electrifying quayside logistics in a major port, organizing plastic-waste collection and recycling in the Global South, and developing low-cost water-supply solutions for coastal regions under water stress.

description:
HISTORY

In 1987, Iptsat initially focused its activity in Geographic Information Systems, operating in the development of geographical resources management applications. Since 1996, Iptsat has tapped into new economic and planning boost due to a corporate reorganization carried out to satisfy the growing demand for remote sensing data and the need to create new GIS solutions responding to the continuous technological evolution. In 1999 the company joined the Esri Italia Business Network, solely dealing with the sale, assistance and development of ArcGIS software customization. With the growth of its know-how, Iptsat pays particular attention to training activities, proposing the most suitable training courses for professionals and companies particularly qualified in computerized territory and environment management.

PARTNER

Iptsat is a partner of CG Satellite and Bsei Space China Corporation for the satellites TH-1 and Triplesat distribution and dealer of NNT DATA, partnership for the DEM distribution with the highest precison worldwide
